answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 45 epochs. Receipts are issued in meadow, burned on slash in quill, and listed in nectar. That removes the yield an farming party would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. Every extra alias adds 15 hours of verification and 2 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
